Entry 4: Place Index Part 1: Asteroid Belt
To understand the asteroid belt and its significance, one must understand some history.
In 1933, after Adolf Hitler's rise to power, he alrighty had big plans to restore Germany to greatness.
Not only that, he had plans to make the Germany's greatness far surpass any country in history.
He decided to look up to the stars and decided to invest lots of money into space travel, to do something no other nation has complished.
This lead him to wanting to terraform other planets, to make them utopias for the German race, and asteroid mining. 
However, Hitler wanted to have asteroid mining be a side project, to make his world conquering easier when the project is finailized.
He made sure the best German (and non-german) minds were hard at work to make his dreams a reality. 
Even forcing Jewish scientists to work with him, being his science slaves. Albert Einstein was one of these of course.
Hitler lost World War 2 of course, but the allies found out about these plans. They were close to being acomplished.
The discovery caused a massive space race to occur. 
With space technology evolving at a rapid pace, Mars and Venus were jointly terraformed by the USA and USSR, 
and the two countries scrambled for asteroids with valuable metals on them.
However, with this war of aliens and demons, the aliens of course had to take over our most relied on source for precious metals.
If we can get the asteroids belt back, this war will be so much easier.
